labels.label: modal or auxiliary verb right before 'also' (it can also)

note: Fires on 'can', 'has' after a subject where 'also' follows; writes, J-lens, logit lens and steering all promote also/Also/juga/auch. Predicts the next word.

labels.label: function word or name piece in headings and questions

note: Common, weak pole (typical 2.2) on 'would', 'Your', 'with', 'uelle', 之後; no shared context, writes and reads are junk; steering gives plain function words.

labels.label: spam or snippet text likely cut off by an ellipsis

note: Writes and steering promote '…⏎⏎' (excerpt truncation); contexts are keyword-spam, stray fragments, 'OVER 3,000,0 0 0'; first-position tokens fire too. Loose.

labels.label: recent-news framing: COVID, reopening, resurgence (not visible in contexts)

note: Writes covid/Putin/tweeted, reads renewed/resurgence/restart and steering gives COVID/重启; but top contexts (tournament, comma, 'There will be', 'few months') show no such topic.

labels.label: reference to the past: old, original, long ago, historically

note: Contexts: 'the old cassette', 'the original', 'a long time ago', 'late 200x'; reads 曾经/当年, writes historically/历史上, steering raises historical words.

labels.label: emphatic stance phrases (never allowed, 高度重视, not only)

note: Writes strict/forbid/严禁/ethics, reads honest/严谨; contexts ('never allowed', '高度重视', 'not only') are loosely a firm-stance register but mixed. Weak.

labels.label: slot before a softening degree word (slightly, 略有)

note: Writes 略有/slightly/稍微 and ablation removes 略有/略微, but contexts (comma, 'a', 'that', 'to') only loosely sit before a hedge. Reads are unrelated.

labels.label: biblical or divine allusion in set phrases (Commandments, Deadly Sins, reborn)

note: Writes divine/scripture/deity/圣经, reads 上帝/基督; contexts are figurative religious idioms (fully formed, Phoenix-style, Two Commandments). Steering +3.5 on 'divine'; outside god labels agree.

labels.label: movement along a route (sailing, riding, highway, journey)

note: Reads 沿途/一路/旅途 and several contexts are travel (航行, 騎, highway), but it writes waiting/nearby/旁边 (stationary): reads travel, writes the static counterpart.

labels.label: slot where 'in transit / along the way / while travelling' fits

note: Writes 一路上/沿途/travel, ablation removes them. Contexts (insured in [transit], car games on trips, circulating currents) point to an upcoming travel phrase.

labels.label: diffuse field-label or attribute token (Attached to:, Hits:, self._)

note: Code-heavy but heterogeneous contexts; writes (limbs, lassen, 一审) and reads (operands, 和平) unrelated; steering tiny (max 0.09). No reading forced.

labels.label: digit, date or closing-quote token where punctuation comes next
first or middle piece of a split multi-token word (scrunched, hummus, pylint)

note: Frequent weak pole (7e-3, similar across slices) peaking on tokens that are word fragments awaiting a continuation; writes are closing tags/ellipsis, reads junk.

labels.label: value that repeats a nearby name in code (self.app = app, stream=stream)

note: All five contexts are Python/C# parameter-to-attribute or keyword assignments; steering raises parameters/Size/layout, writes sizing/spacing. Reads (age, temperature) unrelated.

labels.label: initial value of a min/max/count variable in algorithm code

note: Contexts: int minIndex = 0; max = arr[0]; int count; largest = i. Reads 初始/开始/首次 fit; ablation removes 'if' words (what follows); writes are exclamation junk.

labels.label: indent whitespace after an if/else line in Python, before a statement
colon after a 摘要-style label

note: Three of five contexts are deep indent tokens before raise/return/comment; the others are 本文摘要：and a spam site. Writes (Pirates, until) and reads unrelated.

labels.label: stay-at-home mothers: homemaking and childcare roles

note: Fires on 'stay-at-home', 'left her job to care for her baby', homemakers; writes/reads women/妇女/wives; steering gives mothers; ablation removes childbirth/raising. Outside labels agree.

labels.label: annual festival or recurring event (third annual, 一年一度, Festival)

note: Contexts are inside festival or event names where 'annual' is expected ('organizers of the third annual', Solid Sound Festival, 儿童读书节); writes, reads and steering (+4.0) all annual/每年.

labels.label: month name leading into a day-of-month number (June ⟦ ⟧30)

note: Four of five contexts are dates (July 23, June 30, June 1) plus a phone-number digit; reads are December/国庆/节日; writes (启示, 指导) and steering are junk.

labels.label: newline or indent after a Python import or except line

note: Very common weak pole; top contexts are the line break between 'from django.db import models' and the next import (position 13) and an indent after except. Writes are code-fragment junk.

labels.label: string literal about to hold a format placeholder ({}, %s)

note: Peaks on '{', '://' before {}, '"{' before %s in Python strings; ablation removes {} and ({}); reads ${ and $( are templating syntax; writes are whitespace.

labels.label: comma after 'Mon DD' before the year (Dec 29, 20..)
digit inside a serial or ID number (ISSN, ICP)

note: Three contexts are the comma in 'Jan 28, 20', two are digits in ID codes; writes (赦, 盥) and reads (secretly, nightly) are junk.

labels.label: the word 'left' meaning remaining (copies left, left over)

note: Typical activation 32; every context is 'left' as remaining. Reads LEFT/untouched, writes untouched/unchanged/unfinished/unanswered; steering 4x gives +9 logprob.

labels.label: Chinese clause slot where 最 (most) or a superlative follows

note: Writes and steering are 最有/最难/最受/最强; ablation removes them; reads 唯一/只有; contexts are mostly Traditional-Chinese review prose ('整部電影中，最讓我').

labels.label: character before 字第 in official document numbers (台內營字第)

note: All five contexts are the issuer-character slot in Taiwanese government numbers like 台內營字第90; writes 字第/字, reads 字第/编号/号码; steering +3.9.

labels.label: comparison of similar things, before a comparative (slightly larger, more)

note: Contexts: 'similar to X but', 'they are slightly larger', 'Compared to other systems'; reads differs/differently, writes 更加/更低/smoother/simpler; steering and ablation agree.

labels.label: degree or comparative words and size arithmetic (more flexibility, 比較, *)

note: Reads 更低/最高的/lowest; contexts mix degree words (more flexibility, 比較合理, 松散) with '*' in MAX_SIZE and batch_size arithmetic. Writes (截图, .none) are junk.

labels.label: gaining something new: 'get a whole new', 多了一个, 又有新

note: All contexts are 'X gets a new/added one'; reads 多了, writes 一个重要/最受欢迎/counterpart/利器, steering gives 一个新的 and competitor-type nouns; ablation removes ally/competitor.

labels.label: end of a place name in travel descriptions, before '是' or 'is'

note: Contexts end place names (瓦莱州, 河内, 乌节路, Paris); J-lens writes 是/是一个, reads 是最/renowned/作为, steering raises 是一个/是中国. Predicts a 'X is known for' predicate.

labels.label: stock-phrase openers: 'and so on', 'downward spiral'
Python indent or 'except' after try body

note: Very rare; five contexts mix stock phrases with Python try/except handlers. Write and read reads are junk, so this rests on sparse contexts only.

labels.label: Chinese official policy prose, function words mid-phrase
predicts item-counting words (两项, 这项, 十大)

note: Contexts are mostly Chinese government/legal text (了, 和发展, 工作中); write side promotes 这项/两项/是一项 and steering agrees, but contexts only loosely fit.

labels.label: student-run or simulated activity modifier (undergraduate, mock, student)
predicts real/professional/business contrast

note: Fires on student/mock words before activity nouns (mock stock market, Mock Trial, student newspaper); reads youth/student, writes real/professional/market: student-to-real-world contrast.

labels.label: function word before 'school' in school-life talk (from, to, for)
school/campus/enrollment concept

note: Reads and writes school words; contexts peak on prepositions just before school/lunch/classes. Troublemaker Student fits only the school theme.

labels.label: 'are/was' before predicate (able, not sure, one of)

note: Fires on copula or subject before a predicate adjective; read side (able, unable, reliant, interested) matches. Write reads are junk (HTML fragments).

labels.label: slot before a passive participle (handled, diagnosed, extracted)

note: Noun or 'be' just before 'handled/diagnosed/extracted/mailed'; writes handled/examined/checked/treated, reads 被 and handled. Storyteller Person does not match.

labels.label: digit tokens inside years and DOIs (200_, 10.1007)
math-solution context

note: Three of five contexts are mid-number digits in dates and DOIs; write reads (ToDelete, bulld) are junk. Very rare, sparse evidence.

labels.label: integral / integration (symbols, scipy.integrate, 积分)

note: Fires on dt, int, integrate imports and 积分; reads and writes integration, steering raises integrating by 3 nats at 4x.

labels.label: right before 'suicide' or 'take his own life'

note: Peaks on words preceding suicide (committed, turning the gun on, by jumping, take his); writes suicide strongly (Δlogp 12 at 4x). Fires at the negative pole.

labels.label: word stem needing a suffix (Malays, empath, meteor, legit)

note: Fires on rare word stems that continue with a suffix; writes -ation/-ality/-ated suffixes, reads suffix-like tokens. Fairly common pole across all slices.

labels.label: ' Increment' as stem of Incremental (code identifiers)
stem tokens expecting a suffix

note: All five top contexts are Increment before 'al' (IncrementalEncoder, IncrementalPCA); write reads are junk. Read side shares suffix tokens with the minus pole.

labels.label: sorted word lists, before an entry starting 'ca-'

note: Huge activations in alphabetical keyword or surname lists; reads ca/caul/CAA, writes cat/categor/cate. Contexts only partly fit a ca- next entry (Barn, dave).

labels.label: entry starts in abbreviation or alphabetical lists, before 'CA'/'Cal'

note: Writes Cal/CAL clearly and steering raises them; contexts are quotes or digits in state-code dicts and word lists (71: 'CA'), loosely fitting. Rare.

labels.label: right before 'candidate' or running for election (not run, seek reelection)

note: Fires on not/standing/to/run where candidacy is the next idea; reads and writes 候选人/candidate; steering raises candidate by 13 nats at 4x.

labels.label: mid-expression connectives: operator, comma, 'and its'

note: Frequent, diffuse firing on plus, equals, comma and conjunctions in code and prose. Write reads are CRLF strings, read side is materials; no coherent concept.

labels.label: mid-token pieces and function words, diffuse

note: Fires at 1.6e-2 of positions on unrelated tokens (self, with, 0, ships, disappoint); write reads are Holocaust and punctuation junk. Nothing predictable.

labels.label: style and quality norms context (PEP 8, improve, standards)

note: Contexts mention PEP 8 style and improving to a standard; read side (clean, uniform, syntax) loosely fits. Write reads are junk (生育, _hop).

labels.label: slot predicting 'clean/neat' (a clean seal, finish, look)

note: Fires on 'a' before a quality noun (seal, finish, look) in craft instructions; writes clean/cleaner/干净/整洁, steering raises clean by 8 nats at 4x.

labels.label: anatomy/health context, function word before body or medical noun

note: Writes urine/menstrual/abortion/血压 and steering agrees, but only two of five contexts are anatomical; others are 'of' in lists and PySpark imports.

labels.label: 'essential/fundamental' modifier before services, rights, needs
physiological, basic-needs, infrastructure words

note: Peaks on essential/fundamental/those before services or rights, and 'on' before physiological; writes physiological/infrastructure/utilities. Read side (sensory, utilities) partly fits.

labels.label: period after item number in numbered lists
separators between list items

note: Three of five contexts are the '.' after 4, 9, 10 in numbered lists; the rest are list items. Write reads (â, Î, allele) are junk.

labels.label: item-boundary tokens: opening quote, number, name, colon

note: Diffuse: opening quote in string lists, 'and' between names, colon, digit. Writes quote and closing punctuation tokens; frequent in chat and Chinese.

labels.label: right before 'toilet/bathroom/WC' (use the, go to the, flush)

note: Fires on tokens whose next word is toilet/bathroom (flush, go to, use the, on the); writes toilet/厕所/WC strongly, steering 13 nats at 4x.

labels.label: 'count' in 'count on' (rely on, counting on you)

note: Peaks on count/counting in the idiom meaning rely; reads relied/rely/依赖, writes 依赖/reliance/count. Fires at the negative pole.

labels.label: positions where the next token copies earlier text (names, identifiers)

note: Speculative: AZURE_STORAGE and CIHAN TUĞ repeat earlier strings, but other contexts do not. Read side says rely, which no context shows; write reads are junk.

labels.label: romantic slot before 'love' (I'm in love, still like her, 爱情)

note: Fires on I/still/couldn't in romantic confessions where love is the next idea; writes 爱/love/Love strongly (12 nats at 4x). Fires at the negative pole.

labels.label: the word 'love/loves' itself, affection in lists (love and support)

note: Fires on love or the 'and' right after it; read side is love/loving/浪漫. Write reads (MULTI, 没收, node) are junk, so the output role is unknown.

labels.label: slot right before 'shift/change' (paradigm shift, a change, 大转变)

note: Fires on paradigm, a, subtle, 度 before shift/change; writes shift/转变/转换 (12 nats at 4x), ablation removes 转换/交换. Negative pole.

labels.label: verbs of switching or changing (change, switched, moved) before particle

note: Fires on change/moved/switched/switching; reads 换/切换/转换. Write reads (erver, 侑, holes) are junk; one bash 'then' context is unexplained.

labels.label: slot predicting 'green' (ANSI code 32, GREEN =, 常绿)

note: Fires inside ANSI color escapes before the green digit, after 'GREEN =', and in 终年常绿; writes green/绿/绿色, 11 nats at 4x. Matches sauers: green.

labels.label: the word or color value 'green' itself (green pepper, #00FF00)

note: Fires on ' green' and inside green RGB definitions; reads green/绿/Green. Write reads (zman, ohan, oracle) are junk, so output role unknown.

labels.label: literary context, preposition before an author or work name

note: Fires on like/of/with before Stephen King, Agatha Christie, Ian Banks. Reads prose/literature; writes construction/writing, which only loosely connects.

labels.label: genre slot predicting 'fantasy' (神魔小说, Genre:, 奇幻，科幻)

note: Fires before genre words in book descriptions, English and Chinese; writes fantasy/幻想/神话, reads 科幻/奇幻/诗歌. Contexts are sparse, mostly Chinese.

labels.label: slot predicting male genital word (wrapping around his, tight foreskin)

note: Contexts are possessives and modifiers before penis/foreskin in medical and explicit text. Write side promotes task/status/状态, which does not match; read side includes penis and toolbar.

labels.label: mid-identifier fragments in code and spam text, diffuse

note: Contexts are dist|utils, fl|om|ax, indent and quote slots in Python, and spam; write reads (perms, Template, anal) share no theme with them.

labels.label: XML/web-standard acronyms mid-token (XSL-FO, BPEL, rdf-syntax, xhtml)

note: Four of five contexts are W3C/XML standard names; its plus pole is OWL/ontology. Write reads (Deg, degraded, Iso) and read side show no matching concept.

labels.label: ontology/RDF/OWL context, predicting OWL

note: Fires on Ont(ology), rdflib RDFS imports, #ontology hashtags; writes owl/OWL/Ont, reads .rdf/ontology; steering raises owl by 4 nats at 4x.

labels.label: after brand or material name (Kevlar, Reebok, Converse), before more items

note: Contexts are 'and', 'like' or a bracket after trademark and material names. Writes wire/chain and reads zip/hook, with no clear link to the contexts.

labels.label: fastener slot: buckle, zip, laces (unbuckled, boot laces, seat belt)

note: Fires on fragments before buckle/laces (unb|uckled, sho|el|aces, boot l|aces) and on 'not' before 'properly restrained'; writes buck/zip, reads belt/strap.

labels.label: slot where 'over' comes next (over and over, head on over, to overwrite)

note: Fires on tokens before 'over' (and, on, Stack|over|Flow, to + overwrite); reads over, writes ver/-ver, the piece of 'over'-words. Negative pole.

labels.label: predicts particle 'over' (friends over, sleep over, n over k)

note: Fires on friends/sleep before 'over' and on a binomial n before 'choose k'; writes over/override, 7 nats at 4x. Plus pole of the same neuron as the ver pole.

labels.label: function words in Spanish or Danish text (el, et, TU, causa)

note: Contexts are articles and verbs in non-English text; write side says reports/汇报, which no context supports. Read reads are junk.

labels.label: Spanish determiner before a noun (este documento, el festival)

note: Four of five contexts are Spanish el/este before a noun; read side (reports, 报告) loosely fits 'Descarga este documento'. Write reads (DI, luc, Uint) are junk.

labels.label: marketing-claim slot before 'claims/declares to' (supplement ads)

note: Writes 声明/assertion/declare and reads 宣称/claimed; contexts are supplement-marketing text where a claim verb follows (that declare to), but some contexts are unexplained.

labels.label: fragments of declare/proclaim words (pro|cl|amations, Decl|ared, 声明)

note: Fires inside declar-/proclam- word pieces and on 书面 before 声明; reads statement/声明. Write reads (帮, 撬, 茴) are junk, so output role is unknown.

labels.label: end of a script line, right before an ALL-CAPS speaker name

note: Fires on '.⏎⏎' or '?⏎⏎' before TINA:/MARK/MIKE: in transcripts; writes capital-letter pieces (L, M, LL, MW). Read reads are junk.

labels.label: mid-word piece in all-caps or foreign text before a short continuation

note: Contexts are IND|OS, US|AC, ve'|Im and caps shouting; writes short letter pieces (m, y, A, AAC). Common in zh and chat; diffuse.

labels.label: first pieces of rare multi-token names (Sch|le|icher, Smy|rna, Pal|it)

note: Contexts are name stems awaiting more pieces, plus openerp.service. Write and read sides concern 'pair/pairs/夫妇', which no context shows; reason for the pairing unknown.

labels.label: token right before 'pair'/'对' completes (a pair, /pair, re-pair)
'a/this + 一/这' before 对 meaning a pair

note: Contexts end on P/-p//p/一 just before air/对; writes par/对/пар; reads pairs. Very rare, huge activation. Predicts the next token is pair/对.

labels.label: 'the' in end-times prophecy, before 'Antichrist'
token just before 'Anti' (antichrist, anti-)

note: Four of five contexts are ' the' in Last Days/beast/tribulation text where 'Antichrist' follows; writes Anti/Ant. Read side loosely 'devil'. Fifth context is a Chinese username fragment.

labels.label: mid-word fragment of rare name or identifier
code/module-path or proper-name subword

note: Peaks on incomplete subword pieces (.aut, k, H, Ar, .com) in code, names, Indonesian; word continues next. Writes are junk (解决方案, minimal). Rare, scattered.

labels.label: letter inside spelled-out acronym or spaced word
predicts next letter 'h' / h-word

note: Contexts are letters of B.E.A.C.H, G R A P H S, M a c h, F.A.S.T, I N C E P T; in three the next letter is H/h. Writes here/her/his/h; reads he-tokens.

labels.label: mid-word fragment in letter-spaced or obfuscated words
internal subword of rare English word

note: Peaks on mid-word pieces: ' C' in Popliteal Cyst, spaced 'g r e a t', Cyrillic-lookalike 'ownership', ' wr' in wrinkle. Writes are junk (我不, DEFINE). Scattered, weak.
